snippet.title: 1666 Amsterdam - Early Access Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

As Noa, you take on the mantle of the Collector and unravel a mystery that spans 1666, 1999 and the present day. This dark narrative action adventure comes from Panache Digital Games, the studio founded by Assassin's Creed creator Patrice Désilets. It's in Early Access on PC, with consoles to follow.
